verdict.rationale: Release notes confirm a first-party OCI Generative AI service that can host an imported open model (zai-org/GLM-5.3), but only in one region. OCI generally exposes services through documented REST APIs and SDKs, though no evidence ties these to the inference endpoint specifically. Missing for 10: evidence of frontier/proprietary model availability, documentation of the inference API itself (endpoints, request formats, OpenAI compatibility), a model catalog and region breadth, and independent hands-on corroboration of managed inference.
